title: Continuous Process-Level Evaluation for Evolving Enterprise AI Agent Skills
title_zh: 面向演进中企业AI智能体技能的持续过程级评估

paragraphs.en: Continual Learning for Enterprise AI Agents (CLEA)
paragraphs.zh: 企业AI智能体的持续学习（CLEA）

paragraphs.en: Enterprise AI agent skills are not static artifacts: they are continually revised as tool APIs change, LLM versions update, and skill specifications are refined in response to operational feedback. Yet the standard practice for validating each revision is to check only final-output accuracy—an approach that systematically misses process-level behavioral drift introduced during evolution. We present a continuous evaluation framework for enterprise agentic skills that combines outcome-level and process-level quality checks, applied to two Business Value Determination (BVD) skill variants within an enterprise Value Aware Resiliency (VAR) system. The framework independently computes ground truth per run, instantiates template test cases as persistent regression tests, and assesses tool selection, argument correctness, execution ordering, and database integrity using programmatic checks augmented by a narrowly scoped LLM judge when exact matching would be brittle. We report a fully automatic evaluation over 240 trials spanning two related but structurally distinct skills (Revenue and Productivity apportionment), two specification variants (SKILL.md and Skill.txt), two agent harnesses (Claude Code and Codex), and three models (GPT-5.6-Sol, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Sonnet 4.6). Across the 240 automatic trials, 175 passed all applicable final numerical checks; among them, 162 (92.6%; Wilson 95% CI: 87.7–95.6%) still had at least one additional evaluator-detected deviation. Under a broader seven-check final-state definition, 151/164 passing runs (92.1%; 95% CI: 86.9–95.3%) still violated a trajectory check. Dependency attribution descriptively compressed a mean 6.34 failed checks per run to 2.65 roots. Specification-variant sensitivity also varies with model and harness: unadjusted bootstrap interaction intervals exclude zero for all three Revenue comparisons and for GPT on Productivity, but not for the two remaining Productivity comparisons. Template test cases with runtime-resolved placeholders provide reusable regression coverage across the evaluated specifications, models, and harnesses; longitudinal validation under actual API evolution remains future work.
paragraphs.zh: 企业级智能体技能并非静态产物：随着工具 API 的变化、LLM 版本的更新以及技能规格根据运行反馈的优化，这些技能会持续得到修订。 然而，验证每次修订的标准做法仅检查最终输出的准确性——这种方法系统性地忽略了演化过程中引入的流程层面行为漂移。 我们提出了一种面向企业级智能体技能的持续评估框架，该框架结合了结果层面与流程层面的质量检查，并应用于企业价值感知弹性（VAR）系统中的两种业务价值确定（BVD）技能变体。 该框架为每次运行独立计算基准真相，将模板测试用例实例化为持久的回归测试，并通过程序化检查评估工具选择、参数正确性、执行顺序和数据库完整性；当精确匹配可能不可靠时，还会借助一个作用范围受限的 LLM 裁判进行辅助判断。 我们报告了一项完全自动化的评估，共涵盖 240 次试验，涉及两种相关但结构不同的技能（收入与生产力分配）、两种规格变体（SKILL.md 和 Skill.txt）、两种智能体运行环境（Claude Code 和 Codex）以及三种模型（GPT-5.6-Sol、Claude Opus 4.8、Claude Sonnet 4.6）。 在 240 次自动化试验中，有 175 次通过了所有适用的最终数值检查；其中，仍有 162 次（92.6%；威尔逊 95% CI：87.7–95.6%）存在至少一项由其他评估器检测到的偏差。 在更广泛的七项检查组成的最终状态定义下，164 次通过试验中有 151 次（92.1%；95% CI：86.9–95.3%）仍违反了轨迹检查。 依赖关系归因方法将每次运行平均 6.34 个失败检查描述性压缩为 2.65 个根本原因。 规格变体的敏感性也因模型和运行环境而异：未经调整的自助交互区间在所有三种收入比较中以及 GPT 在生产力方面的比较中均排除了零值，但在其余两种生产力比较中则未排除。 模板测试用例通过运行时解析占位符，为所评估的规格、模型和运行环境提供了可重用的回归测试覆盖；在实际 API 演化环境下的纵向验证仍属未来工作。

paragraphs.en: Enterprise AI agent skills are continuously evolving systems. The skill that handles IT infrastructure cost apportionment today will be revised tomorrow when the observability API version changes, again next month when a new formula is agreed on with the finance team, and again when the underlying LLM is upgraded to the next model version. Each of these changes is an opportunity to introduce behavioral regressions—deviations from the intended process that the skill was designed to follow.
paragraphs.zh: 企业级 AI 智能体的技能是持续演化的系统。 当前负责 IT 基础设施成本分摊的技能，在可观察性 API 版本变更时会被修订，下个月与财务团队商定新公式时也会再次修订，而当底层的 LLM 升级到下一个模型版本时，它还会再次被修订。 每一次这样的变更都是一次引入行为退化的机会——即偏离该技能原本设计所遵循的预期流程。

paragraphs.en: Existing evaluation practice addresses this challenge poorly. Standard evaluation checks whether the final output—a report, a database row, a dollar figure—matches the expected value. But an agent skill can produce a correct-looking final output while taking the wrong steps to get there: calling APIs with incorrect scope, skipping a required database readback, writing intermediate results to the wrong table. These process deviations are invisible to outcome-only checks yet represent genuine behavioral drift that can corrupt downstream agent steps, violate data integrity constraints, or produce correct-by-coincidence outputs that will fail when inputs change slightly. In a continual-adaptation setting—where skills are revised repeatedly in response to operational feedback—these failures compound across revisions, making process-level evaluation an essential component of any responsible deployment loop.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的评估实践未能有效应对这一挑战。 标准评估会检查最终输出——一份报告、一行数据库记录或一个金额数字——是否与预期值一致。 但智能体的技能可能在采取错误步骤的同时生成看似正确的最终输出：例如使用错误的权限范围调用 API、跳过必要的数据库回读操作，或将中间结果写入错误的表。 这些流程偏差在仅检查结果的评估中无法被察觉，但它们确实代表了真实的行为偏离，可能破坏后续智能体步骤、违反数据完整性约束，或产生仅因巧合而正确的输出，而这些输出在输入稍有变化时便会失效。 在持续适应的场景中——即技能会根据运行反馈反复修订——这些失败会随着每次修订而累积，因此流程层面的评估成为任何负责任的部署循环中不可或缺的一环。

paragraphs.en: This paper studies the evaluation layer needed to support continual agent evolution safely, rather than proposing a continual-learning algorithm. We make the case that continuous process-level evaluation is an appropriate quality gate for enterprise agent skills as they evolve. We demonstrate the principle on the Business Value Determination (BVD) skill in an enterprise Value Aware Resiliency (VAR) system. Even when BVD produces the expected final allocation, its trace can violate required scope, persistence, or ordering constraints. A portfolio-total-only outcome check cannot detect these deviations, although finer-grained outcome and process checks can.
paragraphs.zh: 本文研究了支持智能体持续安全演化所需的评价层，而非提出一种持续学习算法。 我们认为，对流程层面的持续评估是企业在智能体技能演化过程中合适的质量关卡。 我们在企业价值感知弹性（VAR）系统中的业务价值确定（BVD）技能上演示了这一原则。 即使 BVD 产生了预期的最终分配结果，其执行过程仍可能违反所需的范围、持续性或顺序约束。 仅对投资组合整体结果进行检查无法检测出这些偏差，而更精细的结果和流程检查则能够发现。

paragraphs.en: An environment-grounded evaluation framework that checks tool selection, arguments, ordering, and database integrity against an oracle computed independently of the evaluated trajectory, augmented by a narrowly scoped LLM judge for semantically flexible arguments.
paragraphs.zh: 一种基于环境的评估框架，该框架将工具选择、参数、顺序和数据库完整性与一个独立于被评估轨迹计算出的“神谕”进行比对，并辅以一个作用范围有限的 LLM 裁判，以处理语义上灵活的参数。

paragraphs.en: A parameterized regression contract whose runtime-resolved placeholders materialize expected scope, multiplicity, and values rather than hardcoding them, with one registered suite reused across all tested configurations (104 cases for Revenue; 80 for Productivity).
paragraphs.zh: 一种参数化回归合约，其运行时解析的占位符会动态生成预期的作用域、多重性和值，而非将其硬编码；所有测试配置均复用同一套已注册的测试用例（收入模块包含104个用例；生产力模块包含80个用例）。

paragraphs.en: Empirical evidence—240 automatic trials spanning two specification variants, two harnesses, and three models—that 162 of 175 trials that pass all applicable final numerical checks still have at least one additional evaluator-detected deviation; even after broadening the baseline to seven final-state checks per skill, 151 of 164 passing runs violate a trajectory check.

paragraphs.en: Sensitivity analyses and root-family decomposition showing that the outcome/process gap persists after excluding external-error runs and spans data consistency, missing phases, allowlist, call-count, and scope checks.
paragraphs.zh: 敏感性分析和根因分解表明，在排除外部错误运行后，结果/过程差异仍然存在，且涉及数据一致性、缺失阶段、允许列表、调用次数和范围检查。

paragraphs.en: Observability platforms, databases, and business systems update their APIs continuously. An agent skill that correctly calls a tool with today’s argument schema may break silently when the tool’s parameter names or scoping semantics change in the next platform release.

sents.en: Observability platforms, databases, and business systems update their APIs continuously.
sents.zh: 可观察性平台、数据库和业务系统会持续更新其 API。

paragraphs.en: As operations teams learn from skill behavior in production, they update the skill’s specification document to codify learned behaviors, close ambiguities, or change business logic. Each revision risks changing the agent’s planning strategy in ways not captured by the outcome metric.
paragraphs.zh: 随着运营团队从生产环境中的技能行为中汲取经验，他们会更新技能的规范文档，以将学到的行为标准化、消除模糊之处或调整业务逻辑。 每次修订都存在改变智能体规划策略的风险，而这些变化可能无法通过结果指标反映出来。

paragraphs.en: When the underlying model is updated—even within a model family—the agent’s default planning choices for ambiguous steps can shift. A step that one model version resolved conservatively might be resolved aggressively by the next, changing which tools are called and in what order.

paragraphs.en: Agents produce unstable outputs across repeated runs on identical inputs; aggregate task-completion metrics can mask tool-use, policy, verification, and memory-recall failures ( Bogavelli et al., 2025 ; Akshathala et al., 2026 ) . In the multi-agent traces analyzed by Cemri et al. (2026) , system-design and task-verification categories account for 63.1% of annotated failures (41.8% and 21.3%, respectively). This distribution identifies substantial system-level improvement opportunities, but does not rule out limitations of the underlying models.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在相同输入上进行重复运行时，会生成不稳定的输出；汇总的任务完成度指标可能会掩盖工具使用、策略、验证和记忆召回方面的失败（Bogavelli 等人，2025；Akshathala 等人，2026）。在 Cemri 等人（2026）分析的多智能体轨迹中，系统设计和任务验证类别占标注失败的 63.1%（分别为 41.8% 和 21.3%）。这一分布揭示了系统层面存在巨大的改进机会，但并未排除底层模型本身的局限性。

paragraphs.en: Flynt (2026) proposes GroundEval, a deterministic alternative to LLM-as-judge for stateful tasks. GroundEval scores an observed trace and final answer against a human-reviewed, machine-checkable state contract covering evidence, time, access, and required searches, rather than against a canonical reference trajectory. Evaluation methods provide complementary signals: deterministic checks offer reproducibility, LLM judges accommodate semantic variation, and human review supports calibration and oversight. Accordingly, Gritta et al. (2026) advocate combining outcome and process evaluation, whereas Zheng et al. (2023) advocate combining capability-based and preference-based benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: Flynt（2026）提出了 GroundEval，这是一种用于状态感知任务的、可确定性的 LLM 裁判替代方案。 GroundEval 通过一个由人工审核且机器可验证的状态合同来评估观测到的轨迹和最终答案；该合同涵盖证据、时间、访问权限和必要搜索，而非与标准参考轨迹进行比对。 评估方法提供了互补的信号：确定性检查确保可重复性，LLM 裁判能够适应语义差异，而人工审核则支持校准与监督。 因此，Gritta 等人 （2026）主张结合结果评估与过程评估，而 Zheng 等人 （2023）则主张结合能力导向和偏好导向的基准测试。

paragraphs.en: Prior studies show that LLM-based evaluation can be sensitive to factors unrelated to response quality, including candidate-response order, verbosity, and model identity ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) . Deterministic rules can instead miss semantically expressed failures; for example, AgentEval reports 0.58 failure-detection recall for 47 hand-crafted rules against human annotations ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . Our framework combines rule-based structural checks with LLM validation of selected semantically flexible arguments and optional failure-only rescue audits. Two authors manually reviewed 60 randomly sampled LLM-judged cases; 57 verdicts agreed with their assessment (95%). This targeted audit reduces, but does not eliminate, judge-validity risk.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究表明，基于大型语言模型（LLM）的评估可能对与回答质量无关的因素较为敏感，包括候选答案与问题之间的顺序、表述的详细程度以及模型的身份（Wang et al., 2024；Zheng et al., 2023）。 相比之下，确定性规则可能会忽略语义上表达的失败情况；例如，AgentEval 针对 47 条人工设计的规则，在与人类标注的对比中，其失败检测召回率仅为 0.58（Guo et al., 2026）。 我们的框架将基于规则的结构检查与 LLM 对选定语义灵活参数的验证相结合，并可选地加入仅针对失败的补救性审核。 两位作者手动审查了 60 个由 LLM 判定的随机抽样案例；其中 57 个判定结果与其评估一致（95%）。 这种有针对性的审核可以降低判决有效性的风险，但无法完全消除该风险。

paragraphs.en: In LLM-generated tests for HumanEval, 88.89% of erroneous test cases studied by Huang et al. (2025) arose from incorrect generated output oracles rather than invalid test inputs; the corresponding oracle-error share ranged from 79.71% to 100% across their seven benchmarks. Our framework computes ground truth by calling the same real APIs the skill uses, independently of the agent execution trace, avoiding dependence on an LLM-generated oracle while retaining the separate risk that live state can change between execution and evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 在 LLM 生成的 HumanEval 测试中，Huang 等人（2025）研究的错误测试用例中，88.89% 源于生成的输出预言机不正确，而非无效的测试输入；在他们研究的七个基准测试中，对应的预言机错误比例介于 79.71% 到 100% 之间。我们的框架通过调用技能所使用的相同真实 API 来计算基准真相，该过程独立于智能体的执行轨迹，从而避免了对 LLM 生成预言机的依赖，但同时也保留了在执行与评估之间实时状态可能发生变化的独立风险。

paragraphs.en: Grading only the final output can reward a correct-looking result reached through a noncompliant or unsupported process. Process evaluation has consequently been advocated for critical agent applications, while process supervision has outperformed outcome-only supervision in mathematical reasoning ( Gritta et al., 2026 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ) . Trajectory-level diagnosis of agent failures from execution traces is demonstrated by Barke et al. (2026) .
paragraphs.zh: 仅对最终输出进行评分，可能会奖励那些通过不符合规范或未受支持的过程得出的看似正确的结果。 因此，在关键智能体应用中，人们开始倡导对过程进行评估，而过程监督在数学推理方面的表现优于仅关注结果的监督（Gritta 等人，2026；Lightman 等人，2024）。 Barke 等人（2026）展示了如何根据执行轨迹对智能体失败进行轨迹层面的诊断。

paragraphs.en: Automated regression testing and continuous monitoring in production ML provide a software-engineering precedent for continuous skill quality assurance ( Breck et al., 2017 ) . Guo et al. (2026) apply this idea to agentic tasks through AgentEval, which uses a dependency-modeled DAG to chain step-level checks and improve root-cause accuracy, making it closely related to our framework. We extend this direction with two additions absent from AgentEval: (i) runtime-resolved template test cases designed to be reused as skill specifications, tool APIs, and input portfolios evolve; and (ii) live-API ground truth computed independently of the agent execution, designed to avoid dependence on self-generated oracles—a failure mode illustrated by high generated-oracle error shares in automated test generation ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . Unlike AgentEval, whose evaluation DAG is instantiated around a specific workflow execution, our regression artifact resolves expected values from the current enterprise environment at evaluation time. Our experiments establish reuse across configurations, not yet longitudinal persistence under API change.
paragraphs.zh: 生产环境机器学习系统中的自动化回归测试和持续监控为技能质量的持续保障提供了软件工程领域的先例（Breck 等，2017）。Guo 等 （2026）通过 AgentEval 将这一理念应用于智能体任务：AgentEval 使用依赖建模的有向无环图（DAG）将各步骤的检查环节串联起来，以提高根本原因分析的准确性，因此与我们的框架密切相关。 我们在这一方向上增加了 AgentEval 所不具备的两个要素：（i）运行时解析的模板测试用例，这些用例旨在随着技能规范、工具 API 和输入组合的演变而重复使用；以及（ii）独立于智能体执行过程计算的实时 API 基准数据，其设计目的是避免依赖自生成“神谕”——自动化测试生成中自生成“神谕”的高错误比例（Huang 等，2025）正是这种失效模式的一个例证。 与 AgentEval 不同，AgentEval 的评估 DAG 是围绕特定的工作流执行实例构建的；而我们的回归测试构件则在评估时从当前的企业环境中解析预期值。 我们的实验证明了该方案在不同配置间的可重复使用性，但尚未验证其在 API 变更环境下的长期持久性。

paragraphs.en: VAR is an enterprise resiliency agent system that measures application resilience against business-defined SLOs. It consists of a pipeline of LLM-powered agentic skills: Business Value Determination (BVD), Assess Attribution, Application Optimizer, Diagnosis, Recommendation Generation, Recommendation Impact Estimator, and Recommendation Optimizer. Skills are implemented as Claude Code or Codex sessions directed by a skill specification document and equipped with tools from two MCP servers: the VAR MCP Server (23 tools; stateless; fetches utilization data from Instana, Kubecost, and ServiceNow) and the VAR Data Access MCP Server (18 tools; manages persistent session state, result storage, and apportionment tables in SQLite).
paragraphs.zh: VAR 是一个企业弹性智能体系统，用于衡量应用程序在业务定义的 SLO（服务等级目标）下的弹性。 它由一个基于 LLM 的智能体技能流程组成：业务价值确定（BVD）、归因评估、应用程序优化器、诊断、推荐生成、推荐影响估算器和推荐优化器。 这些技能以 Claude Code 或 Codex 会话的形式实现，由技能规范文档指导，并配备来自两个 MCP 服务器的工具：VAR MCP 服务器（23 个工具；无状态；从 Instana、Kubecost 和 ServiceNow 获取使用数据）以及 VAR 数据访问 MCP 服务器（18 个工具；管理持久会话状态、结果存储和 SQLite 中的分配表）。

paragraphs.en: BVD is Step 0 of VAR. Given an application portfolio, a date range, and an annual revenue figure, BVD queries observability APIs to retrieve per-application CPU, memory, and call-count utilization, then allocates business value proportionally (default weights: CPU 40%, memory 40%, calls 20%). Outputs are written to a persistent database read by all downstream skills. Errors in BVD therefore corrupt the entire remaining pipeline. We study two related but operationally different skills. Revenue Apportionment allocates prorated portfolio revenue across nine applications from CPU, memory, and call volume. It stages the complete monitoring response, reads it back, computes allocation, and writes separate host- and application-level revenue tables; its suite contains 104 checks. Productivity Apportionment additionally retrieves Kubernetes costs from Kubecost and EC2 unblended cost from Cloudability, requires EC2 resource identifiers, splits host cost among applications, computes revenue-to-cost productivity with explicit NULL semantics, and writes a different application table; its suite contains 80 checks. The skills therefore share resource-based revenue allocation but not the same tool set, persistence contract, or workflow depth.
paragraphs.zh: BVD 是 VAR 的第 0 步。 给定一个应用组合、一个日期范围和一个年度收入数值，BVD 会查询可观测性 API，获取每个应用的 CPU、内存和调用次数利用率，然后按业务价值进行比例分配（默认权重：CPU 40%、内存 40%、调用 20%）。 输出结果会被写入一个持久化数据库，所有下游技能均可读取该数据库。 因此，BVD 中的错误会破坏整个后续流程。 我们研究了两种相关但在操作上不同的技能。 收入分配技能根据 CPU、内存和调用量，将组合收入按比例分配到九个应用中。 该技能分阶段生成完整的监控响应，将其读回，计算分配结果，并分别写入主机级和应用级的收入表；其技能套件包含 104 项检查。 生产力分配技能还会从 Kubecost 获取 Kubernetes 成本，从 Cloudability 获取 EC2 未混合成本，需要 EC2 资源标识符，将主机成本拆分到各个应用，使用明确的 NULL 语义计算收入与成本之比以得出生产力指标，并写入一个不同的应用表；其技能套件包含 80 项检查。 因此，这两种技能共享基于资源的收入分配机制，但使用的工具集、持久化协议或工作流深度并不相同。

sents.en: Given an application portfolio, a date range, and an annual revenue figure, BVD queries observability APIs to retrieve per-application CPU, memory, and call-count utilization, then allocates business value proportionally (default weights: CPU 40%, memory 40%, calls 20%).
sents.zh: 给定一个应用组合、一个日期范围和一个年度收入数值，BVD 会查询可观测性 API，获取每个应用的 CPU、内存和调用次数利用率，然后按业务价值进行比例分配（默认权重：CPU 40%、内存 40%、调用 20%）。

sents.en: Outputs are written to a persistent database read by all downstream skills.
sents.zh: 输出结果会被写入一个持久化数据库，所有下游技能均可读取该数据库。

sents.en: Errors in BVD therefore corrupt the entire remaining pipeline.
sents.zh: 因此，BVD 中的错误会破坏整个后续流程。

sents.en: We study two related but operationally different skills.
sents.zh: 我们研究了两种相关但在操作上不同的技能。

sents.en: Revenue Apportionment allocates prorated portfolio revenue across nine applications from CPU, memory, and call volume.
sents.zh: 收入分配技能根据 CPU、内存和调用量，将组合收入按比例分配到九个应用中。

sents.en: It stages the complete monitoring response, reads it back, computes allocation, and writes separate host- and application-level revenue tables; its suite contains 104 checks.
sents.zh: 该技能分阶段生成完整的监控响应，将其读回，计算分配结果，并分别写入主机级和应用级的收入表；其技能套件包含 104 项检查。

sents.en: Productivity Apportionment additionally retrieves Kubernetes costs from Kubecost and EC2 unblended cost from Cloudability, requires EC2 resource identifiers, splits host cost among applications, computes revenue-to-cost productivity with explicit NULL semantics, and writes a different application table; its suite contains 80 checks.
sents.zh: 生产力分配技能还会从 Kubecost 获取 Kubernetes 成本，从 Cloudability 获取 EC2 未混合成本，需要 EC2 资源标识符，将主机成本拆分到各个应用，使用明确的 NULL 语义计算收入与成本之比以得出生产力指标，并写入一个不同的应用表；其技能套件包含 80 项检查。

sents.en: The skills therefore share resource-based revenue allocation but not the same tool set, persistence contract, or workflow depth.
sents.zh: 因此，这两种技能共享基于资源的收入分配机制，但使用的工具集、持久化协议或工作流深度并不相同。

paragraphs.en: MD and TXT denote paired instruction artifacts, not a controlled file-format manipulation. For Revenue, TXT is a substantial condensation (904 versus 1,379 words): it removes the tool-reference table and many exact output and warning requirements while retaining staging, readback, allocation, and persistence. For Productivity, TXT is only modestly shorter (1,318 versus 1,405 words) and adds operational content absent from MD, including an explicit duration formula, the [ 0.01 , 1 ] [0.01,1] normalization range, exclusion of non-portfolio applications, a combined EC2 cost query, and CSV export. MD–TXT differences therefore estimate sensitivity to the complete revision (syntax, length, and instruction content together), not a causal effect of formatting alone. Both variants delegate deterministic arithmetic to tools.
paragraphs.zh: MD 和 TXT 表示成对的指令产物，而非受控的文件格式操作。 在“收入”部分，TXT 是大幅度的精简（904 词对比 1,379 词）：它移除了工具参考表以及许多具体的输出和警告要求，但保留了分阶段处理、读回、分配和持久性要求。 在“生产力”部分，TXT 仅略短一些（1,318 词对比 1,405 词），并补充了 MD 中缺失的操作内容，包括一个明确的持续时间公式、[ 0.01 , 1 ] [0.01,1] 归一化范围、排除非投资组合应用、合并的 EC2 成本查询以及 CSV 导出功能。 因此，MD–TXT 的差异反映了完整修订（语法、长度和指令内容共同作用）的敏感度，而非单纯格式变化所导致的因果效应。 两种变体都将确定性算术计算委托给工具执行。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation framework operates as a five-stage pipeline, independent of the agent session under evaluation (Figure 1 ).

paragraphs.en: A single line appended to the skill specification’s first step directs the agent to record all parsed input parameters (portfolio, date range, revenue) to a structured log. The agent’s full tool-call trace—tool name, arguments, return value, and conversation turn index—is captured from the harness execution log.

paragraphs.en: A standalone Python script calls the same real APIs the skill uses via an independent execution path, and computes expected per-application apportionment values. This independence is critical: on HumanEval, 88.89% of the erroneous LLM-generated test cases analyzed by Huang et al. (2025) were caused by incorrect output oracles rather than invalid test inputs. Live calls make the reference responsive to current API state, but execution and evaluation can observe different snapshots; we treat this as a validity threat rather than evidence of correctness under API evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 一个独立的 Python 脚本通过独立的执行路径调用该技能所使用的相同真实 API，并计算每个应用程序的预期分配值。 这种独立性至关重要：在 HumanEval 数据集上，Huang 等人（2025）分析的 LLM 生成的错误测试用例中，有 88.89% 是由错误的输出判据而非无效的测试输入所导致的。 （2025）是由错误的输出判据而非无效的测试输入所导致的。 实时调用使参考结果能够反映当前 API 的状态，但执行和评估过程可能观察到不同的快照；我们将此视为有效性的威胁，而非 API 演化过程中正确性的证据。

paragraphs.en: We distinguish three evaluation layers. Level 1 contains the pre-specified final numerical outcomes: application revenue for Revenue, and application revenue, total cost, and productivity for Productivity. Level 2 broadens this to seven final-state checks per skill: the Level 1 values plus other stored values and normalization sums, and required response structure. Level 3 contains the remaining trajectory checks described below. This separation tests whether trajectory evaluation adds detection even after a richer final state, rather than only after a deliberately narrow numerical baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将评估分为三个层级。 第一层级包含预先指定的最终数值结果：收入模块的应用收入，以及生产力模块的应用收入、总成本和生产力。 第二层级将其扩展为每项技能的七项最终状态检查：第一层级的数值，加上其他存储的数值和归一化总和，以及所需的响应结构。 第三层级包含下文描述的其余轨迹检查。 这种分离旨在检验：即使拥有更丰富的最终状态，轨迹评估是否仍能增强检测能力，而不仅仅是依赖一个刻意设定的狭窄数值基准。

paragraphs.en: Tool selection : required tools called; no irrelevant tools invoked.
paragraphs.zh: 工具选择：已调用必需工具；未调用无关工具。

paragraphs.en: Tool arguments : date ranges, filters, and numeric parameters checked with typed constraints. Candidate-call selection and structural checks are rule based. The LLM judge ( claude-sonnet-4-6 ) is invoked only for designated checks where exact matching is too brittle, such as semantically equivalent SQL or alternative argument representations; its requested numeric comparisons are executed through a calculator tool. Selected failed programmatic checks may also receive a failure-only judge-rescue audit. It therefore supplements rather than replaces the programmatic suite and does not discover candidate calls. Two authors manually reviewed 60 randomly sampled LLM-judged cases; 57 verdicts agreed with the authors’ assessment (95%).
paragraphs.zh: 工具参数：日期范围、筛选器和数值参数均经过类型约束验证。 候选调用选择与结构检查基于规则执行。 LLM 裁判（claude-sonnet-4-6）仅在指定检查中被调用，用于精确匹配过于脆弱的情况，例如语义等价的 SQL 或替代参数表示；其请求的数值比较通过计算器工具执行。 被选中的程序检查失败项也可能接受仅针对失败的裁判-救援审计。 因此，它是对程序检查套件的补充，而非替代，且不会发现候选调用。 两位作者手动审查了 60 个随机抽取的 LLM 裁判案例；其中 57 个裁决与作者的评估一致（95%）。

paragraphs.en: Tool ordering : required phase sequence enforced by comparing conversation turn indices (fetch → \to stage → \to readback → \to allocate → \to write).
paragraphs.zh: 工具排序：通过比较对话轮次索引强制执行所需的阶段序列（获取 → \to 准备 → \to 复述 → \to 分配 → \to 写入）。

paragraphs.en: Argument scope : per-cluster and per-host tool calls checked for under-coverage (missing calls) and over-coverage (calls with wrong scope values).
paragraphs.zh: 论证范围：检查每个集群和每个主机的工具调用是否存在覆盖不足（缺失的调用）和覆盖过度（具有错误作用域值的调用）的问题。

paragraphs.en: When a skill specification is condensed or a tool API changes, the model’s behavior at ambiguous steps shifts. Outcome checks approve the new behavior if the final number is still right. Process checks catch the behavioral shift itself—irrespective of whether it accidentally produces the correct final output—and surface it as a regression for human review before deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 当技能规范被简化或工具 API 发生变化时，模型在模糊步骤上的行为也会随之改变。 结果检查会批准这种新行为，只要最终数值仍然正确。 流程检查则会捕捉到行为本身的转变——无论这种转变是否偶然产生了正确的最终输出——并在部署前将其作为回归问题提交给人工审核。

paragraphs.en: When a check fails, the framework traverses the authored dependency graph to distinguish designated root failures from cascaded failures . A cascaded failure is attributed to its root cause, preventing developers from spending time on each downstream symptom independently. The report lists roots with cascaded descendants to reduce the initial review set; these graph-derived roots are descriptive, not validated causal explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 当检查失败时，该框架会遍历已构建的依赖图，以区分指定的根因故障与级联故障。 级联故障的归因于其根本原因，从而避免开发者对每个下游症状进行独立排查。 报告列出了具有级联子节点的根因，以减少初始审查范围；这些源自图的根因仅为描述性信息，而非经过验证的因果解释。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate two related BVD-family skills with independently computed ground truth: Revenue Apportionment (104 template test cases) and Productivity Apportionment (80 template test cases). They share utilization retrieval and revenue allocation, but Productivity adds cost retrieval, cost allocation, NULL handling, and a different persistence contract (§4).

sents.zh: 我们评估了两种相关的 BVD 家族技能，它们具有独立计算的基准真相：收入分配（104 个模板测试用例）和生产力分配（80 个模板测试用例）。

sents.en: They share utilization retrieval and revenue allocation, but Productivity adds cost retrieval, cost allocation, NULL handling, and a different persistence contract (§4).

paragraphs.en: A real enterprise portfolio of nine applications across three infrastructure platforms (two Kubernetes clusters, one EC2 host) and annual revenue $1,200,000. Revenue trials use 2026-05-01 through 2026-05-15; Productivity trials use 2026-07-01 through 2026-07-15. Utilization is retrieved live from Instana, while Productivity additionally queries Kubecost and Cloudability. Comparisons are therefore made within skill; the study does not interpret cross-skill differences as effects under a shared data snapshot.
paragraphs.zh: 一个真实的企业应用组合，涵盖三个基础设施平台（两个 Kubernetes 集群、一个 EC2 主机）上的九款应用程序，年收入为 1,200,000 美元。 收入测试使用的时间段为 2026-05-01 至 2026-05-15；生产力测试使用的时间段为 2026-07-01 至 2026-07-15。 利用率从 Instana 实时获取，而生产力测试还会额外查询 Kubecost 和 Cloudability。 因此，比较是在同一技能范围内进行的；该研究并未将跨技能的差异解释为共享数据快照下的影响。

One archived Productivity Codex–Sonnet TXT result contained six legacy Cloudability checks not present in the registered 80-check suite. paragraphs.en: The conclusion is robust to two error filters. Of the 33 runs with external errors, 31 pass all applicable final numerical checks and all 31 retain an additional deviation. Excluding those runs gives 131/144 (91.0%; Wilson 95% CI: 85.2–94.6%). Separately, excluding every run with an unrecovered error gives 136/147 (92.5%; Wilson 95% CI: 87.1–95.8%). Across the complete suite, 227 of 240 runs (94.6%; Wilson 95% CI: 91.0–96.8%) fail at least one check.

paragraphs.en: Among the 162 outcome-correct but flagged trials, non-exclusive root families are data or numerical consistency (106), missing phase or required tool (66), allowlist violations (55), redundancy or call-count violations (43), scope/filter violations (13), response format (2), and tool execution (1). These counts distinguish the observed gap from a single evaluator artifact, but they do not assign severity and can sum beyond 162. Because many allowlist hits are harness utilities or schema operations, we also remove the no_irrelevant_tools check entirely as a sensitivity test; all 162 outcome-correct flagged runs still retain another failed check.
paragraphs.zh: 在 162 个结果正确但被标记的试验中，非排他性根家族包括数据或数值一致性（106）、缺少阶段或所需工具（66）、允许列表违规（55）、冗余或调用次数违规（43）、范围/筛选器违规（13）、响应格式（2）以及工具执行（1）。 这些计数将观察到的差距与单个评估者的误差区分开来，但它们并未指定严重程度，且总和可能超过 162。 由于许多允许列表命中是测试工具或模式操作，我们还完全移除了 no_irrelevant_tools 检查作为敏感性测试；所有 162 个结果正确但被标记的运行仍然保留另一个失败的检查。

paragraphs.en: Of 240 trials, 164 pass all seven skill-specific final-state checks defined in §6. Among these, 151 (92.1%; Wilson 95% CI: 86.9–95.3%) still violate at least one trajectory check; removing no_irrelevant_tools leaves this count unchanged. The skill-level rates are 109/109 for Revenue and 42/55 (76.4%) for Productivity. paragraphs.en: Template test cases with runtime-resolved placeholders function as reusable regression artifacts for enterprise agentic skills, analogous to unit tests in software CI/CD. Each time the skill specification is revised, a new model version is deployed, or a tool API changes, the same template test cases re-execute against the new version and immediately surface any behavioral regressions at the process level. This reuse is possible precisely because placeholders are resolved at evaluation time from live API state, not hardcoded at test-writing time: the test that checks “database readback was called before allocation” is as meaningful for the v1.0 specification as it is for v1.7, and for Sonnet 4.6 as it is for Opus 4.8 or GPT-5.6-Sol. After removing six legacy checks retained in one archived result, all 24 model–harness–variant–skill conditions use one registered suite per skill. Across archived materializations, the same check IDs cover four distinct Revenue and 16 distinct Productivity expected-value states, demonstrating runtime resolution under observed reference variation. This does not test controlled input or API evolution or establish maintenance-free validity after semantic changes; Appendix A reports a post hoc staleness analysis. Prospectively, the report could serve as a merge gate by flagging new roots or a configurable root-count threshold, but we do not evaluate production merge decisions or repair effectiveness.

paragraphs.en: A key finding from the 240-trial automatic evaluation is that sensitivity to the paired MD/TXT specification revisions can depend jointly on model, harness, and skill type. GPT-5.6-Sol is variant-robust on Claude Code for Revenue Apportionment ( − - 1.2 pp gap) yet becomes the most variant-sensitive model on Codex ( + + 12.9 pp). Conversely, Sonnet 4.6 is moderately sensitive on Claude Code ( + + 6.3 pp) but variant-robust on Codex ( − - 0.4 pp). Bootstrap interaction intervals exclude zero for all three Revenue comparisons and for GPT on Productivity; the Productivity Opus and Sonnet comparisons remain inconclusive. The supported inversions show that the effect of a complete specification revision can change across harnesses. Because MD and TXT also differ in content, the study cannot attribute these effects to formatting itself. A specification validated on one harness should therefore be re-evaluated after migration.
paragraphs.zh: 240次试验的自动评估得出一个关键发现：对成对的MD/TXT规范修订的敏感度可能同时取决于模型、测试框架和技能类型。 GPT-5.6-Sol在Claude Code的“收入分配”任务上对不同变体的表现较为稳定（− - 1.2个百分点的差距），但在Codex上却成为对变体最敏感的模型（+ + 12.9个百分点）。 相反，Sonnet 4.6在Claude Code上表现出中等敏感度（+ + 6.3个百分点），但在Codex上则对不同变体表现稳定（− - 0.4个百分点）。 Bootstrap交互区间在所有三项“收入”比较中以及GPT在“生产力”任务上的结果均排除了零值；而“生产力”任务中Opus和Sonnet的比较结果仍无法确定。 支持的反向结果表明，完整规范修订的影响可能因测试框架的不同而发生变化。 由于MD和TXT在内容上也存在差异，该研究无法将这些影响归因于格式本身。 因此，在一个测试框架上经过验证的规范，在迁移到另一个框架后应重新进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Computation tools are the system’s operational baseline in every reported condition; the experiment therefore estimates neither a tool-encapsulation effect nor arithmetic instability without tools. Its supported claim is observational: even among 175 runs with correct final numerical outcomes, 162 contain another evaluator-detected deviation. More conservatively, 151/164 runs that pass all seven broader final-state checks still violate a trajectory check. These deviations span multiple root families and persist when the allowlist check is removed. Process-level regression tests therefore add coverage beyond the chosen final state, while the operational severity of each deviation remains domain specific.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有已报告的条件中，计算工具都是该系统的运行基准；因此，该实验既未估计工具封装效应，也未估计无工具时的算术不稳定性。 其支持的论断基于观察：即使在 175 次运行中获得正确最终数值结果的情况下，仍有 162 次存在评估器检测到的其他偏差。 更保守地看，在通过全部七项较宽泛的最终状态检查的 164 次运行中，仍有 151 次违反了轨迹检查。 这些偏差涉及多个根源类别，并且在移除白名单检查后依然存在。 因此，进程级别的回归测试扩展了所选最终状态之外的覆盖范围，而每种偏差的实际严重程度仍取决于具体领域。

paragraphs.en: Across 240 trials, 162/175 runs with correct final numerical outcomes contained another evaluator-detected deviation; under the broader final-state baseline, 151/164 passing runs still violated a trajectory check. Dependency attribution reduced 6.34 failed checks to 2.65 roots per run on average. These results show that process-level regression tests complement final-state evaluation, while template reuse and harness-dependent sensitivity motivate re-evaluation as enterprise skills evolve.

paragraphs.en: MD and TXT are bundled specification variants rather than a controlled format intervention. They differ in syntax, length, detail, and sometimes semantics—most notably, Productivity TXT adds exclusion, normalization, combined-cost-query, and CSV-export requirements. The observed gaps cannot therefore be causally attributed to file format or condensation alone.
paragraphs.zh: MD 和 TXT 是捆绑在一起的规格变体，而非受控的格式干预。 它们在语法、长度、细节以及某些情况下语义上有所不同——最显著的是，Productivity TXT 增加了排除、规范化、组合成本查询和 CSV 导出等要求。 因此，观察到的差异不能仅归因于文件格式或压缩本身。

paragraphs.en: The aggregate suite score combines heterogeneous outcome and process checks. It does not encode failure severity, and dependency-linked checks are not statistically independent; category-specific root-failure rates are therefore needed before interpreting small score differences operationally.
paragraphs.zh: 综合套件得分将异质的结果和流程检查整合在一起。 它并未编码故障的严重程度，且与依赖关系相关的检查在统计上并非独立；因此，在从操作层面解释微小的得分差异之前，需要针对特定类别确定根本故障率。

paragraphs.en: The traces contain execution noise: 83/240 runs record at least one tool or harness error. External and unrecovered errors are overlapping rather than nested categories: 175 runs have neither, 32 have an unrecovered but no external error, 22 have an external but no unrecovered error, and 11 have both. Thus 33 runs have external errors and 43 have unrecovered errors. External-error totals are nearly balanced by harness (Claude Code: 16; Codex: 17) but uneven across cells, whereas unrecovered errors are concentrated in Codex runs (Claude Code: 5; Codex: 38). Harness and variant contrasts may therefore partly reflect infrastructure and execution reliability. We retain all runs as an intention-to-evaluate analysis; future work should preregister retry and exclusion rules and report cell-level clean-run contrasts. The aggregate unrecovered-error sensitivity is not a substitute for such cell-level analysis: excluding these runs removes all 20 Productivity Codex–Sonnet observations, so it cannot validate that configuration or its interaction estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 这些痕迹包含执行噪声：在 240 次运行中，有 83 次记录至少出现一个工具或框架错误。 外部错误与未恢复错误是相互重叠而非嵌套的分类：175 次运行均未出现这两种错误，32 次仅出现未恢复错误而未出现外部错误，22 次仅出现外部错误而未出现未恢复错误，另有 11 次同时出现两者。 因此，有 33 次运行出现了外部错误，43 次运行出现了未恢复错误。 外部错误的总数几乎被框架错误所平衡（Claude Code：16；Codex：17），但不同单元格之间的分布并不均匀；而未恢复错误则主要集中在 Codex 的运行中（Claude Code：5；Codex：38）。 因此，框架和变体之间的差异可能部分反映了基础设施和执行可靠性。 我们保留所有运行，以进行“评价意向”分析；未来研究应预先登记重试和排除规则，并报告单元格级别的干净运行对比。 总体未恢复错误的敏感度不能替代这种单元格级别的分析：如果排除这些运行，将导致所有 20 个 Productivity Codex–Sonnet 的观察结果被移除，因此无法验证该配置或其交互效应的估计值。

paragraphs.en: The frequent EC2-memory disagreement was not introduced by a specification revision. The tool can return host/JVM memory where no defensible per-application split exists, whereas the authored invariant expects zero. Writing the test exposed an implicit policy choice: what should be stored when a per-application split is impossible? The raw results therefore identify a specification gap, but do not by themselves prove that zero is the uniquely correct value. The same issue arises when the Productivity oracle expects zero EC2 cost but some executions allocate nonzero Cloudability cost. This pattern recurred for DB readback ordering and EC2 call scope. In each case, specifying the expected behavior surfaced an assumption that the skill specification had not made explicit. This distinction permits multiple valid trajectories rather than equating one canonical trace with operational correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 频繁出现的 EC2 与内存之间的不一致并非由规范修订所引起。 该工具可能会返回主机/JVM 内存，而实际上并不存在可合理支持的应用程序级划分；但作者设定的不变量则期望其值为零。 编写测试暴露出一个隐性的策略选择：当无法进行应用程序级划分时，应当存储什么？ 因此，原始结果揭示了一个规范上的空白，但本身并不能证明零就是唯一正确的值。 当生产力预言机期望 EC2 成本为零，但某些执行过程却分配了非零的 Cloudability 成本时，也会出现同样的问题。 这种模式在数据库读回排序和 EC2 调用作用域中反复出现。 在每个案例中，明确预期行为都揭示了一个技能规范未曾明确说明的假设。 这种区分允许存在多种有效路径，而不是将某个标准追踪等同于操作正确性。

paragraphs.en: The evaluator is normative: in 71/240 trials its “irrelevant tool” check is a root failure, sometimes for harness utilities, schema initialization, or namespace aliases of unestablished harm. Ordering and zero-valued EC2 memory/cost checks also encode workflow policy. The unchanged 162/175 result after removing the allowlist check shows that this issue does not explain the headline gap, but domain review, equivalent-trace tests, and severity labels are still needed to separate harmful from benign behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 评估器具有规范性：在 71/240 次试验中，其“无关工具”检查是根本性故障，有时涉及工具集实用程序、模式初始化或未确立危害的名称空间别名。 排序和零值的 EC2 内存/成本检查也编码了工作流程策略。 在移除允许列表检查后，结果仍为不变的 162/175，表明该问题无法解释主要差距，但仍需通过领域审查、等效追踪测试和严重程度标签来区分有害行为与良性行为。

paragraphs.en: Live-API ground truth can drift between execution and deferred evaluation, so immutable response snapshots would strengthen reference integrity. Our targeted two-author audit found agreement on 57 of 60 randomly sampled LLM-judged cases (95%), but this should not be interpreted as general judge accuracy: the sample was drawn over judgments rather than runs, its coverage across check types was not stratified, the reviewers were authors rather than external annotators, and the audit does not separately characterize the failure-only rescue path. Calculator-backed arithmetic reduces but does not remove semantic-judgment risk. Moreover, the judge model (Claude Sonnet 4.6) is also one of the evaluated models, so correlated or self-preference bias may affect judgments of its traces. The manually authored invariants and dependency graph may require maintenance as tool semantics evolve. The experiments compare fixed configurations rather than a longitudinal API or model upgrade, so persistence under actual evolution remains untested. Both skills also use one portfolio, one revenue value, and one date window each; repeated stochastic trials do not provide environmental input diversity. In a post hoc staleness simulation, freezing the modal Productivity expected values would place at least one value outside its registered tolerance in 80/120 Productivity runs, whereas observed Revenue variation remained within tolerance. This counterfactual and the materialization analysis support runtime resolution under observed reference variation, not controlled evolution. Finally, the framework diagnoses but does not repair failures.
paragraphs.zh: Live-API 的基准数据在执行与延迟评估之间可能会发生漂移，因此不可修改的响应快照将有助于增强参考数据的完整性。 我们针对两位作者的审计发现，在随机抽取的 60 个由 LLM 判定的案例中，有 57 个达成了一致（95%），但这不应被解读为判定者具有普遍准确性：该样本是从判定结果中抽取的，而非从运行实例中抽取；其覆盖的检查类型未进行分层；评审人员是作者而非外部标注员；且此次审计并未单独描述仅发生失败时的恢复路径。 使用计算器的算术运算可以降低语义判断的风险，但无法完全消除。 此外，判定模型（Claude Sonnet 4.6）本身也是被评估的模型之一，因此相关性偏差或自我偏好偏差可能会影响对其运行轨迹的判定。 手动编写的不变量和依赖图可能需要随着工具语义的演变而进行维护。 这些实验比较的是固定配置，而非长期使用的 API 或模型升级，因此在实际演化环境下的持久性尚未得到验证。 这两种技能均各自使用一个投资组合、一个收入值和一个日期窗口；重复的随机试验并未提供环境输入多样性。 在一次事后陈旧性模拟中，若冻结“生产力”模态的预期值，则至少有 120 次“生产力”运行中的 80 次会出现至少一个超出其注册容限的值，而观测到的“收入”变化仍在容限范围内。 这一反事实分析与具体化分析共同支持在观测到参考数据变化时进行运行时解决，而非依赖受控演化。 最后，该框架能够诊断故障，但无法修复故障。

paragraphs.en: The cost analysis uses harness-recorded USD estimates rather than reconciled provider invoices. Pricing rules, cache accounting, and provider contracts can differ across harnesses and models, and unusually expensive retries can create heavy tails. Consequently, the cost results characterize these 240 executions and should not be interpreted as an intrinsic price advantage of a harness.
paragraphs.zh: 成本分析使用的是 harness 中记录的美元估算值，而非经过核对的供应商发票。 定价规则、缓存会计和供应商合同可能因 harness 和模型而异，且异常昂贵的重试操作可能导致长尾分布。 因此，这些成本结果反映了这 240 次执行的情况，不应被解释为某个 harness 固有的价格优势。

paragraphs.en: Across all 240 runs, harness telemetry reports $859.34 total cost: mean $3.58 (SD $4.50), median $1.23, and range $0.45–$30.23 per run. Claude Code averages $1.04 versus $6.12 for Codex under the balanced design. Within each skill and pooling variants, Codex/Claude-Code mean-cost ratios are 5.9–6.0 × \times for Opus and 8.8–10.2 × \times for Sonnet, but 1.0–1.4 × \times for GPT. For Claude models, cache-read tokens comprise 90.7–92.9% of recorded Claude Code tokens versus 0% on Codex, consistent with caching as a major accounting difference. These are recorder-estimated, observational costs rather than invoice-validated causal effects. Mean runtime in seconds for Claude Code/Codex is 416/238 for GPT, 254/450 for Opus, and 284/344 for Sonnet; the Codex–Opus mean is inflated by one 7,152-second run (median: 241 seconds).
paragraphs.zh: 在所有 240 次运行中，系统遥测报告总成本为 $859.34：每次运行的平均成本为 $3.58（标准差 $4.50），中位数为 $1.23，范围为 $0.45–$30.23。 在平衡设计下，Claude Code 的平均成本为 $1.04，而 Codex 则为 $6.12。 在每个技能和池化变体中，Codex/Claude-Code 的平均成本比对于 Opus 为 5.9–6.0 × \times，对于 Sonnet 为 8.8–10.2 × \times，但对于 GPT 则为 1.0–1.4 × \times。 对于 Claude 模型，缓存读取的 token 占记录到的 Claude Code token 的 90.7–92.9%，而 Codex 中这一比例为 0%，这与缓存作为主要成本差异来源的情况一致。 这些是记录器估算的观察性成本，而非经过发票验证的因果效应。 Claude Code/Codex 的平均运行时间（单位：秒）分别为 GPT 的 416/238、Opus 的 254/450 和 Sonnet 的 284/344；Codex–Opus 的平均值因一次持续 7,152 秒的运行而被拉高（中位数为 241 秒）。
